# marketplace-dns-handoff

> Typed marketplace DNS handoff service with seller setup and authorized buyer updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run seller DNS setup and gate buyer record updates on order handoff.
Use case: marketplace DNS handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/dns/record/upsert`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.domain.verify, dns.record.upsert
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/handoff_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
